title: What is React Query
description: Understand React Query and its role in managing server state.

data.text: **React Query** (now TanStack Query) is a data-fetching and state management library for React. It handles caching, background updates, and stale data out of the box.

items: **Caching**: Automatic caching with configurable stale times
**Optimistic updates**: Update UI before server confirms

data.text: Server state is data stored on a server that you fetch and display. Client state is UI state like form inputs or modals. React Query manages server state; useState manages client state.

data.title: Not a Global Store
data.text: React Query is not a replacement for Redux. It's a server state manager that handles caching and synchronization with your backend.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: React Query simplifies server state management.
